# GitHub Copilot Prompts Agent Instructions

## Owner

- `baldin_project_manager`.

## Scope

- Applies to Copilot `.prompt.md` slash-command files.

## Do

- Keep prompts single-purpose and owner-aware.
- Update the cookbook decision table for prompt lifecycle changes.

- Do not preserve weak or overlapping prompts.
- Do not make prompts the canonical source for repo policy.

## Validation

- Run the agentic validator when requested.
- Check cookbook alignment for prompt additions or retirements.

## Handback Notes

- Report prompt classification and intended owner.
